title: EmbodiedWorld-200K: Toward Embodied World Agents via Embodied-Planning Dataset and Interactive World Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.25959v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Building embodied agents that can perceive, reason, and act across diverse 3D worlds is a central research direction toward artificial general intelligence. Yet most existing work remains confined to specific tasks in a single scene and transfers poorly to new environments, leaving general embodied agents for open-world settings under-explored. We refer to such agents as Embodied World Agents (EWAs), whose defining property is the ability to understand diverse visual environments and execute general actions in open-world conditions. To advance EWA research, we study open-world embodied navigation-planning and release EmbodiedWorld-200K, a large-scale dataset of over 200K samples spanning diverse scenes. Each example is equipped with multi-level annotations, ranging from low-level camera-motion trajectories to high-level semantic instructions. translated_title: EmbodiedWorld-200K：通过具身规划数据集与交互式世界模型迈向具身世界智能体
translated_abstract: 构建能够在多样化3D世界中感知、推理和行动的具身智能体，是迈向通用人工智能的核心研究方向。然而，现有的大多数工作仍局限于单一场景中的特定任务，且难以迁移到新环境，导致面向开放世界环境的通用具身智能体研究尚不充分。我们将这类智能体称为具身世界智能体（EWAs），其核心特征是能够理解多样化的视觉环境并在开放世界条件下执行通用动作。为推动EWA研究，我们研究了开放世界具身导航规划，并发布了EmbodiedWorld-200K——一个包含超过20万个样本、覆盖多样化场景的大规模数据集。每个样本都配备有多层次标注，涵盖从低层次相机运动轨迹到高层次语义指令等不同粒度。该数据集还提供了统一的评估划分和针对特定任务的评估指标，支持……
tldr: 该论文提出具身世界智能体（EWA）的概念，并发布了首个包含20万以上样本、具备从低层轨迹到高层语义指令多层次标注的开放世界具身导航规划大规模数据集EmbodiedWorld-200K，以推动开放世界通用具身智能体研究。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concept of Embodied World Agents (EWAs) and releases EmbodiedWorld-200K, a large-scale dataset of over 200K samples with multi-level annotations—from low-level camera-motion trajectories to high-level semantic instructions—for open-world embodied navigation-planning, advancing the development of general embodied agents for open-world settings.
